```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = NA)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(modelsummary)
library(openxlsx)
library(systemfit)
library(car)
library(broom)
library(estimatr)
library(kableExtra)

pdf_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, landscape_mode = FALSE, font_size = NULL,
                      col_groups = NULL, notes = NULL, scale_down = FALSE) {
  drop <- names(df) %in% c("part", "statistic") | grepl("^spacer_", names(df))
  visible <- df[, !drop, drop = FALSE]
  tbl <- kbl(visible, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
             caption = caption, linesep = "", row.names = FALSE)
  opts <- "HOLD_position"
  if (scale_down || landscape_mode) opts <- c(opts, "scale_down")
  tbl <- kable_styling(tbl,
    latex_options = opts,
    font_size = font_size, position = "center")
  if (!is.null(notes)) {
    tbl <- footnote(tbl, general = notes, general_title = "Notes: ",
                    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, threeparttable = TRUE, escape = FALSE)
  }
  if (landscape_mode) tbl <- landscape(tbl)
  tbl
}

# --- Standard table notes (significance legend only) ---
note_sig <- "$\\\\dagger$ p < 0.10, * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001."
note_base_ext <- note_sig
note_extended <- note_sig
note_iv <- note_sig

key_findings <- function(models_list, caption = "Key Findings: Treatment Effects", ...) {
  ef <- get_treatment_effects(models_list, ...)
  display <- ef %>%
    transmute(
      Model = paste0("(", model, ")"),
      Outcome = DV,
      Controls = controls,
      Estimate = sprintf("%.4f%s", B, sig),
      SE = sprintf("(%.4f)", SE),
      `p-value` = sprintf("%.4f", p)
    )
  kbl(display, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = caption,
      linesep = "", escape = TRUE, align = c("l","l","l","r","r","r")) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 9,
                  latex_options = "hold_position") %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
}

# --- HELPER FUNCTIONS ---

get_treatment_effects <- function(models_list, vcov_spec = ~department_std,
                                   dv_names = NULL, iv_name = "treatment") {
  if (is.null(dv_names)) {
    dv_names <- sapply(models_list, function(m) {
      as.character(formula(m))[2]
    })
  }
  results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(models_list), function(i) {
    model <- models_list[[i]]
    if (inherits(model, "iv_robust")) {
      coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
      if (iv_name %in% rownames(coef_summary)) {
        treatment_row <- coef_summary[iv_name, ]
        estimate <- treatment_row["Estimate"]
        std_error <- treatment_row["Std. Error"]
        p_value <- treatment_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
      } else {
        estimate <- NA; std_error <- NA; p_value <- NA
      }
    } else {
      est <- modelsummary::get_estimates(model, vcov = vcov_spec)
      treatment_row <- est[est$term == iv_name, ]
      if (nrow(treatment_row) == 0) {
        estimate <- NA; std_error <- NA; p_value <- NA
      } else {
        estimate <- treatment_row$estimate
        std_error <- treatment_row$std.error
        p_value <- treatment_row$p.value
      }
    }
    t_stat <- if (!is.na(estimate) && !is.na(std_error) && std_error != 0) {
      estimate / std_error
    } else { NA }
    data.frame(
      model = i, DV = dv_names[i], IV = iv_name,
      controls = ifelse(i %% 2 == 0, "Extended", "Base"),
      B = round(estimate, 4), SE = round(std_error, 4),
      t = round(t_stat, 3), p = round(p_value, 4),
      sig = case_when(
        is.na(p_value) ~ "", p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01 ~ "**", p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        p_value < 0.1 ~ "+", TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )
  }))
  rownames(results) <- NULL
  return(results)
}

run_regression_clustered <- function(formula, input_data) {
  model <- lm(formula, data = input_data)
  model$cluster_data <- input_data
  return(model)
}

vcov_cluster_custom <- function(x) {
  if(!is.null(x$cluster_data)) {
    vcovCL(x, cluster = x$cluster_data$department_std)
  } else {
    vcovCL(x, cluster = x$model$department_std)
  }
}

add_fixed_effects_rows <- function(table_base, before_constant = TRUE) {
  col_names <- names(table_base)
  fe_rows <- data.frame(
    part = rep("estimates", 3),
    term = c("Date/Time When Seminar Organizers were Contacted",
             "Randomization Stratum", "Discipline"),
    statistic = rep("", 3), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for(col in col_names[4:length(col_names)]) {
    fe_rows[[col]] <- rep("Yes", 3)
  }
  if(before_constant) {
    constant_row <- which(table_base$term == "Constant" & table_base$statistic == "estimate")
    if(length(constant_row) > 0) {
      table_export <- rbind(table_base[1:(constant_row-1), ], fe_rows, table_base[constant_row:nrow(table_base), ])
    } else {
      gof_row <- which(table_base$part == "gof")[1]
      if(!is.na(gof_row)) {
        table_export <- rbind(table_base[1:(gof_row-1), ], fe_rows, table_base[gof_row:nrow(table_base), ])
      } else {
        table_export <- rbind(table_base, fe_rows)
      }
    }
  } else {
    gof_row <- which(table_base$part == "gof")[1]
    if(!is.na(gof_row)) {
      table_export <- rbind(table_base[1:(gof_row-1), ], fe_rows, table_base[gof_row:nrow(table_base), ])
    } else {
      table_export <- rbind(table_base, fe_rows)
    }
  }
  return(table_export)
}

add_spacer_columns <- function(table_df, group_size = 2) {
  col_names <- names(table_df)
  model_cols <- col_names[grepl("^\\(", col_names)]
  n_models <- length(model_cols)
  if (n_models <= group_size) return(table_df)
  meta_cols <- col_names[1:3]
  new_col_order <- meta_cols
  spacer_counter <- 1
  for (i in seq_along(model_cols)) {
    new_col_order <- c(new_col_order, model_cols[i])
    if (i %% group_size == 0 && i < n_models) {
      spacer_name <- paste0("spacer_", spacer_counter)
      table_df[[spacer_name]] <- ""
      new_col_order <- c(new_col_order, spacer_name)
      spacer_counter <- spacer_counter + 1
    }
  }
  table_df <- table_df[, new_col_order]
  return(table_df)
}

add_custom_spacers <- function(table_df, after_positions) {
  col_names <- names(table_df)
  model_cols <- col_names[grepl("^\\(", col_names)]
  meta_cols <- col_names[1:3]
  new_col_order <- meta_cols
  spacer_counter <- 1
  for (i in seq_along(model_cols)) {
    new_col_order <- c(new_col_order, model_cols[i])
    if (i %in% after_positions) {
      spacer_name <- paste0("spacer_", spacer_counter)
      table_df[[spacer_name]] <- ""
      new_col_order <- c(new_col_order, spacer_name)
      spacer_counter <- spacer_counter + 1
    }
  }
  table_df <- table_df[, new_col_order]
  return(table_df)
}

compute_simple_effect <- function(model, x_val, treat_name = "treatment", interact_name = NULL) {
  coefs <- coef(model)
  vcov_mat <- vcovCL(model, cluster = ~department_std)
  b_treat <- as.numeric(coefs[treat_name])
  b_interact <- as.numeric(coefs[interact_name])
  var_treat <- as.numeric(vcov_mat[treat_name, treat_name])
  var_interact <- as.numeric(vcov_mat[interact_name, interact_name])
  cov_treat_interact <- as.numeric(vcov_mat[treat_name, interact_name])
  effect <- b_treat + b_interact * x_val
  se <- sqrt(var_treat + x_val^2 * var_interact + 2 * x_val * cov_treat_interact)
  t_stat <- effect / se
  p_val <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = model$df.residual)
  return(list(effect = effect, se = se, t = t_stat, p = p_val))
}

run_subgroup_model <- function(formula_str, data) {
  model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = data)
  model$cluster_data <- data
  return(model)
}
```

```{r balance-helpers, include=FALSE}
# --- Balance table helper functions ---

REPL_BAL <- ".."
N_PERM <- 5000
set.seed(20260307)

strat_dept <- c("bin_0_1", "bin_1_3", "bin_3_5", "bin_5_7", "bin_7_11", "bin_11_17")
strat_sem  <- c(strat_dept, paste0("batch_", 1:9))

# Panel A covariates (department-level) — must match 02_manuscript_analysis.Rmd
panel_a_vars <- list(
  list(var = "n_seminars", label = "# of Seminars Hosted by Department", type = "num"),

  list(var = "disc_physics", label = "Physics Department", type = "ind"),
  list(var = "total_faculty", label = "Number of Faculty in Department", type = "num"),
  list(var = "frac_black_faculty", label = "% Black Faculty in Department", type = "pct"),
  list(var = "frac_hispanic_faculty", label = "% Hispanic Faculty in Department", type = "pct"),
  list(var = "frac_women_faculty", label = "% Female Faculty in Department", type = "pct"),
  list(var = "frac_dept_chair_black", label = "% Department Chairs who are Black", type = "pct"),
  list(var = "frac_dept_chair_hispanic", label = "% Department Chairs who are Hispanic", type = "pct"),
  list(var = "frac_dept_chair_female", label = "% Department Chairs who are Female", type = "pct")
)

# Panel B covariates (seminar-level) — must match 02_manuscript_analysis.Rmd
panel_b_vars <- list(
  list(var = "num_recipients", label = "Number of Email Recipients", type = "num"),
  list(var = "frac_seminar_organizer_black", label = "% Seminar Organizers who are Black", type = "pct"),
  list(var = "frac_seminar_organizer_hispanic", label = "% Seminar Organizers who are Hispanic", type = "pct"),
  list(var = "frac_seminar_organizer_female", label = "% Seminar Organizers who are Female", type = "pct")
)

panel_a_varnames <- sapply(panel_a_vars, `[[`, "var")
panel_b_varnames <- sapply(panel_b_vars, `[[`, "var")

format_row_bal <- function(data, v) {
  ctrl <- data[[v$var]][data$treatment == 0]
  treat <- data[[v$var]][data$treatment == 1]
  all_vals <- data[[v$var]]
  if (v$type %in% c("pct", "ind")) {
    overall <- sprintf("%.2f%%", mean(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
    control <- sprintf("%.2f%%", mean(ctrl, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
    treatment <- sprintf("%.2f%%", mean(treat, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
  } else {
    overall <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE), sd(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
    control <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(ctrl, na.rm = TRUE), sd(ctrl, na.rm = TRUE))
    treatment <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(treat, na.rm = TRUE), sd(treat, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  n_obs <- sum(!is.na(all_vals))
  data.frame(Characteristic = v$label, Overall = overall, Control = control,
             Treatment = treatment, pvalue = "", N = n_obs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

ri_individual_t <- function(data, var, strata_fe, vcov_fn, perm_tvecs) {
  data_clean <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]))
  if (nrow(data_clean) < 10) return(NA_real_)
  formula <- as.formula(paste(var, "~ treatment +", paste(strata_fe, collapse = " + ")))
  get_t <- function(d) {
    m <- lm(formula, data = d)
    ct <- tryCatch(coeftest(m, vcov. = vcov_fn(m)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ct) || !"treatment" %in% rownames(ct)) return(NA_real_)
    abs(ct["treatment", "t value"])
  }
  t_obs <- get_t(data_clean)
  if (is.na(t_obs)) return(NA_real_)
  n_ge <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(perm_tvecs))) {
    data_clean$treatment <- perm_tvecs[match(
      as.character(data_clean[[attr(perm_tvecs, "dept_col")]]),
      attr(perm_tvecs, "dept_ids")), i]
    t_perm <- get_t(data_clean)
    if (!is.na(t_perm) && t_perm >= t_obs) n_ge <- n_ge + 1L
  }
  n_ge / ncol(perm_tvecs)
}

ri_joint_f <- function(data, covariates, strata_fe, vcov_fn, perm_tvecs) {
  data_cc <- data[complete.cases(data[, covariates]), ]
  if (nrow(data_cc) < 10) return(list(F_obs = NA, ri_p = NA, df1 = NA, df2 = NA, N = 0))
  formula <- as.formula(paste("treatment ~", paste(strata_fe, collapse = " + "), "+",
                               paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  get_F <- function(d) {
    m <- lm(formula, data = d)
    testable <- intersect(covariates, names(coef(m))[!is.na(coef(m))])
    if (length(testable) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    f <- linearHypothesis(m, paste0(testable, " = 0"),
                          vcov = vcov_fn(m), singular.ok = TRUE, test = "F")
    f$F[2]
  }
  F_obs <- get_F(data_cc)
  if (is.na(F_obs)) return(list(F_obs = NA, ri_p = NA, df1 = NA, df2 = NA, N = nrow(data_cc)))
  m_full <- lm(formula, data = data_cc)
  testable <- intersect(covariates, names(coef(m_full))[!is.na(coef(m_full))])
  f_full <- linearHypothesis(m_full, paste0(testable, " = 0"),
                             vcov = vcov_fn(m_full), singular.ok = TRUE, test = "F")
  n_ge <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(perm_tvecs))) {
    data_cc$treatment <- perm_tvecs[match(
      as.character(data_cc[[attr(perm_tvecs, "dept_col")]]),
      attr(perm_tvecs, "dept_ids")), i]
    f_perm <- get_F(data_cc)
    if (!is.na(f_perm) && f_perm >= F_obs) n_ge <- n_ge + 1L
  }
  list(F_obs = F_obs, ri_p = n_ge / ncol(perm_tvecs),
       df1 = f_full$Df[2], df2 = f_full$Res.Df[2], N = nrow(data_cc))
}

generate_permutations <- function(dept_data, dept_col, n_perm) {
  dept_data$strata_id <- apply(dept_data[, strat_dept], 1, paste, collapse = "_")
  dept_ids <- as.character(dept_data[[dept_col]])
  perm_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(dept_ids), ncol = n_perm)
  for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    perm <- dept_data$treatment
    for (s in unique(dept_data$strata_id)) {
      idx <- dept_data$strata_id == s
      perm[idx] <- sample(perm[idx])
    }
    perm_mat[, i] <- perm
  }
  attr(perm_mat, "dept_ids") <- dept_ids
  attr(perm_mat, "dept_col") <- dept_col
  perm_mat
}

build_balance_output <- function(dept_data, sem_data, dept_col, sample_label) {
  cat(sprintf("\n--- Building %s balance table ---\n", sample_label))
  n_dept <- nrow(dept_data)
  n_sem <- nrow(sem_data)

  cat(sprintf("  Generating %d permutations...\n", N_PERM))
  perm_dept <- generate_permutations(dept_data, dept_col, N_PERM)
  vcov_hc3 <- function(m) vcovHC(m, type = "HC3")

  # --- Panel A: Department-level ---
  cat("  Panel A (department-level)...\n")
  panel_a_rows <- lapply(panel_a_vars, function(v) format_row_bal(dept_data, v))
  panel_a_df <- do.call(rbind, panel_a_rows)
  for (i in seq_along(panel_a_vars)) {
    v <- panel_a_vars[[i]]
    cat(sprintf("    RI for %s...\n", v$var))
    p <- ri_individual_t(dept_data, v$var, strat_dept, vcov_hc3, perm_dept)
    panel_a_df$pvalue[i] <- if (is.na(p)) "" else sprintf("%.3f", p)
    panel_a_df$N[i] <- sum(!is.na(dept_data[[v$var]]))
  }
  cat("    Joint F-test Panel A...\n")
  f_a <- ri_joint_f(dept_data, panel_a_varnames, strat_dept, vcov_hc3, perm_dept)

  # --- Panel B: Seminar-level ---
  cat("  Panel B (seminar-level)...\n")
  panel_b_rows <- lapply(panel_b_vars, function(v) format_row_bal(sem_data, v))
  panel_b_df <- do.call(rbind, panel_b_rows)
  for (i in seq_along(panel_b_vars)) {
    v <- panel_b_vars[[i]]
    cat(sprintf("    RI for %s...\n", v$var))
    sem_clean <- sem_data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[v$var]]))
    if (nrow(sem_clean) < 10) { panel_b_df$pvalue[i] <- ""; next }
    formula <- as.formula(paste(v$var, "~ treatment +", paste(strat_sem, collapse = " + ")))
    get_vcov_cl <- function(m) vcovCL(m, cluster = sem_clean[[dept_col]])
    get_t <- function(d) {
      m <- lm(formula, data = d)
      ct <- tryCatch(coeftest(m, vcov. = get_vcov_cl(m)), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(ct) || !"treatment" %in% rownames(ct)) return(NA_real_)
      abs(ct["treatment", "t value"])
    }
    t_obs <- get_t(sem_clean)
    if (is.na(t_obs)) { panel_b_df$pvalue[i] <- ""; next }
    n_ge <- 0L
    for (j in seq_len(N_PERM)) {
      sem_clean$treatment <- perm_dept[match(
        as.character(sem_clean[[dept_col]]), attr(perm_dept, "dept_ids")), j]
      t_perm <- get_t(sem_clean)
      if (!is.na(t_perm) && t_perm >= t_obs) n_ge <- n_ge + 1L
    }
    panel_b_df$pvalue[i] <- sprintf("%.3f", n_ge / N_PERM)
    panel_b_df$N[i] <- nrow(sem_clean)
  }

  cat("    Joint F-test Panel B...\n")
  sem_cc <- sem_data[complete.cases(sem_data[, panel_b_varnames]), ]
  if (nrow(sem_cc) >= 10) {
    formula_b <- as.formula(paste("treatment ~", paste(strat_sem, collapse = " + "), "+",
                                   paste(panel_b_varnames, collapse = " + ")))
    get_F_b <- function(d) {
      m <- lm(formula_b, data = d)
      testable <- intersect(panel_b_varnames, names(coef(m))[!is.na(coef(m))])
      if (length(testable) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      f <- linearHypothesis(m, paste0(testable, " = 0"),
                            vcov = vcovCL(m, cluster = d[[dept_col]]),
                            singular.ok = TRUE, test = "F")
      f$F[2]
    }
    F_obs_b <- get_F_b(sem_cc)
    m_b <- lm(formula_b, data = sem_cc)
    testable_b <- intersect(panel_b_varnames, names(coef(m_b))[!is.na(coef(m_b))])
    f_b_full <- linearHypothesis(m_b, paste0(testable_b, " = 0"),
                                  vcov = vcovCL(m_b, cluster = sem_cc[[dept_col]]),
                                  singular.ok = TRUE, test = "F")
    n_ge_b <- 0L
    for (j in seq_len(N_PERM)) {
      sem_cc$treatment <- perm_dept[match(
        as.character(sem_cc[[dept_col]]), attr(perm_dept, "dept_ids")), j]
      f_perm <- get_F_b(sem_cc)
      if (!is.na(f_perm) && f_perm >= F_obs_b) n_ge_b <- n_ge_b + 1L
    }
    f_b <- list(F_obs = F_obs_b, ri_p = n_ge_b / N_PERM,
                df1 = f_b_full$Df[2], df2 = f_b_full$Res.Df[2], N = nrow(sem_cc))
  } else {
    f_b <- list(F_obs = NA, ri_p = NA, df1 = NA, df2 = NA, N = 0)
  }

  # --- Assemble output ---
  header_a <- data.frame(
    Characteristic = sprintf("Panel A: Department-Level Characteristics (N = %d)", n_dept),
    Overall = "", Control = "", Treatment = "", pvalue = "", N = n_dept, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  ftest_a_str <- if (!is.na(f_a$F_obs)) sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f", f_a$df1, f_a$df2, f_a$F_obs) else ""
  ftest_a_p <- if (!is.na(f_a$ri_p)) sprintf("%.3f", f_a$ri_p) else ""
  ftest_a_row <- data.frame(Characteristic = "Joint F-test (RI p-value)", Overall = ftest_a_str,
    Control = "", Treatment = "", pvalue = ftest_a_p, N = f_a$N, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  header_b <- data.frame(
    Characteristic = sprintf("Panel B: Seminar-Level Characteristics (N = %d)", n_sem),
    Overall = "", Control = "", Treatment = "", pvalue = "", N = n_sem, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  ftest_b_str <- if (!is.na(f_b$F_obs)) sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f", f_b$df1, f_b$df2, f_b$F_obs) else ""
  ftest_b_p <- if (!is.na(f_b$ri_p)) sprintf("%.3f", f_b$ri_p) else ""
  ftest_b_row <- data.frame(Characteristic = "Joint F-test (RI p-value)", Overall = ftest_b_str,
    Control = "", Treatment = "", pvalue = ftest_b_p, N = f_b$N, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  output <- rbind(header_a, panel_a_df, ftest_a_row, header_b, panel_b_df, ftest_b_row)
  cat(sprintf("  Done. Output has %d rows.\n", nrow(output)))
  output
}
```

```{r table-s3-itt, include=FALSE}
clean_name <- function(x) {
  x %>% str_replace_all("[\u2013\u2014]", "-") %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>% str_to_lower() %>% str_trim()
}
standardize_discipline <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(as.character(x))
  case_when(str_detect(x, "computer") ~ "Computer Science", str_detect(x, "mechanic") ~ "Mechanical Engineering",
    str_detect(x, "math") ~ "Mathematics", str_detect(x, "physic") ~ "Physics",
    str_detect(x, "chem") ~ "Chemistry", TRUE ~ x)
}
standardize_university <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_name(x)
  x <- str_replace(x, "rutgers university.new brunswick", "rutgers university")
  x <- str_replace(x, "rutgers university, new brunswick", "rutgers university")
  x <- str_replace(x, "university of wisconsin.madison", "university of wisconsin")
  x <- str_replace(x, "university of wisconsin, madison", "university of wisconsin")
  x <- str_replace(x, "university of wisconsin.milwaukee", "university of wisconsin")
  x <- str_replace(x, "university of wisconsin, milwaukee", "university of wisconsin")
  x
}

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Rankings and peer department variables ---
itt_rankings_raw <- read.csv(file.path(raw_dir_itt, "department_rankings.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(university = standardize_university(university))

itt_disc_rank_map <- c(Physics = "physics_rank", Chemistry = "chemistry_rank",
  Mathematics = "math_rank", `Computer Science` = "cs_rank", `Mechanical Engineering` = "me_rank")

itt_missing_sets <- list(
  Physics = itt_rankings_raw$university[itt_rankings_raw$missing_physics == 1],
  Chemistry = itt_rankings_raw$university[itt_rankings_raw$missing_chemistry == 1],
  Mathematics = itt_rankings_raw$university[itt_rankings_raw$missing_math == 1],
  `Computer Science` = itt_rankings_raw$university[itt_rankings_raw$missing_cs == 1],
  `Mechanical Engineering` = itt_rankings_raw$university[itt_rankings_raw$missing_me == 1]
)

itt_disc_db_map <- c(Physics = "physics", Chemistry = "chemistry", Mathematics = "mathematics",
  `Computer Science` = "computer_science", `Mechanical Engineering` = "mechanical_engineering")

itt_urm_dbs <- list()
for (dn in names(itt_disc_db_map)) {
  dbf <- file.path(raw_dir_itt, "urm_faculty_databases", paste0(itt_disc_db_map[[dn]], ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(dbf)) {
    itt_urm_dbs[[dn]] <- read.csv(dbf, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      transmute(university = standardize_university(Schools)) %>%
      group_by(university) %>% summarise(n_urm = n(), .groups = "drop")
  }
}

itt_compute_peer <- function(univ, disc) {
  rank_col <- itt_disc_rank_map[[disc]]
  if (is.null(rank_col)) return(data.frame(total_peer_departments = NA_integer_, total_urm_peer_faculty = NA_integer_))
  ranked <- itt_rankings_raw[!is.na(itt_rankings_raw[[rank_col]]), ]
  ranked <- ranked[order(ranked[[rank_col]], ranked$university), ]
  ranked_unis <- unique(ranked$university)
  fi <- match(univ, ranked_unis)
  if (is.na(fi)) return(data.frame(total_peer_departments = NA_integer_, total_urm_peer_faculty = NA_integer_))
  nr <- length(ranked_unis)
  lo <- max(1L, fi - 20L); hi <- min(nr, fi + 20L)
  get_p <- function(l, h) setdiff(ranked_unis[seq.int(l, h)], univ)
  peers <- get_p(lo, hi)
  while (length(peers) < 40L && (lo > 1L || hi < nr)) {
    if (lo > 1L) lo <- lo - 1L; if (hi < nr) hi <- hi + 1L
    peers <- get_p(lo, hi)
  }
  urm_db <- itt_urm_dbs[[disc]]
  if (is.null(urm_db)) return(data.frame(total_peer_departments = length(peers), total_urm_peer_faculty = 0L))
  count_urm <- function(p) { m <- match(p, urm_db$university); sum(urm_db$n_urm[m[!is.na(m)]]) }
  tu <- count_urm(peers)
  while (tu < 20L && (lo > 1L || hi < nr)) {
    if (lo > 1L) lo <- lo - 1L; if (hi < nr) hi <- hi + 1L
    peers <- get_p(lo, hi)
    tu <- count_urm(peers)
  }
  data.frame(total_peer_departments = length(peers), total_urm_peer_faculty = as.integer(tu))
}

itt_univ_disc <- itt_faculty %>% distinct(university_std, discipline_std)
peer_list <- mapply(itt_compute_peer, itt_univ_disc$university_std, itt_univ_disc$discipline_std, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
itt_peers <- cbind(itt_univ_disc, do.call(rbind, peer_list))

itt_rank_data <- itt_univ_disc %>%
  left_join(itt_rankings_raw %>% select(university, physics_rank, chemistry_rank, math_rank,
    cs_rank, me_rank, general_rank) %>% rename(university_std = university),
    by = "university_std") %>%
  mutate(
    dept_ranking_raw = case_when(
      discipline_std == "Physics" ~ physics_rank, discipline_std == "Chemistry" ~ chemistry_rank,
      discipline_std == "Mathematics" ~ math_rank, discipline_std == "Computer Science" ~ cs_rank,
      discipline_std == "Mechanical Engineering" ~ me_rank, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    missing_dept_rank = case_when(
      discipline_std == "Physics" ~ as.integer(university_std %in% itt_missing_sets$Physics | is.na(dept_ranking_raw)),
      discipline_std == "Chemistry" ~ as.integer(university_std %in% itt_missing_sets$Chemistry | is.na(dept_ranking_raw)),
      discipline_std == "Mathematics" ~ as.integer(university_std %in% itt_missing_sets$Mathematics | is.na(dept_ranking_raw)),
      discipline_std == "Computer Science" ~ as.integer(university_std %in% itt_missing_sets$`Computer Science` | is.na(dept_ranking_raw)),
      discipline_std == "Mechanical Engineering" ~ as.integer(university_std %in% itt_missing_sets$`Mechanical Engineering` | is.na(dept_ranking_raw)),
      TRUE ~ as.integer(is.na(dept_ranking_raw))),
    dept_ranking = ifelse(missing_dept_rank == 1L, general_rank, dept_ranking_raw),
    dept_ranking = coalesce(dept_ranking, general_rank)
  ) %>%
  select(university_std, discipline_std, dept_ranking, missing_dept_rank)

# --- Recipient counts (568 departments) ---

  mutate(
    parts = str_split(department, "-", n = 2),

  ) %>%

in_final <- original %>%
  filter(seminar_id %in% final_for_itt$seminar_id) %>%

cols_itt <- c("seminar_id", "university_std", "discipline_std", "treatment",
```

```{r semester-heterogeneity-test}
semester_long <- bind_rows(
  final_data %>%
    mutate(semester = "Fall", pct_black_sem = fall_pct_black, num_black_sem = fall_num_black,
           any_black_sem = has_any_black_fall, pct_urm_sem = fall_pct_urm, num_urm_sem = fall_num_urm,
           any_urm_sem = has_any_urm_fall, pct_hispanic_sem = fall_pct_hispanic,
           num_hispanic_sem = fall_num_hispanic, any_hispanic_sem = has_any_hispanic_fall),
  final_data %>%
    mutate(semester = "Spring", pct_black_sem = spring_pct_black, num_black_sem = spring_num_black,
           any_black_sem = has_any_black_spring, pct_urm_sem = spring_pct_urm, num_urm_sem = spring_num_urm,
           any_urm_sem = has_any_urm_spring, pct_hispanic_sem = spring_pct_hispanic,
           num_hispanic_sem = spring_num_hispanic, any_hispanic_sem = has_any_hispanic_spring)
)
semester_long$semester <- factor(semester_long$semester, levels = c("Fall", "Spring"))

sem_het_rows <- list()
for (info in list(
  list(dv = "pct_black_sem", label = "% Black"), list(dv = "num_black_sem", label = "# Black"),
  list(dv = "any_black_sem", label = "Any Black"), list(dv = "pct_urm_sem", label = "% URM"),
  list(dv = "num_urm_sem", label = "# URM"), list(dv = "any_urm_sem", label = "Any URM"),
  list(dv = "pct_hispanic_sem", label = "% Hispanic"), list(dv = "num_hispanic_sem", label = "# Hispanic"),
  list(dv = "any_hispanic_sem", label = "Any Hispanic")
)) {
  m <- lm(as.formula(paste(info$dv, "~ -1 + semester + treatment:semester +", controls_extended)), data = semester_long)
  het_test <- linearHypothesis(m, "semesterSpring:treatment - semesterFall:treatment = 0",
    vcov = vcovCL(m, cluster = ~department_std), singular.ok = TRUE, test = "F")
  p <- het_test$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  sem_het_rows[[length(sem_het_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Outcome = info$label,
    `F-stat` = sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f", het_test$Df[2], het_test$Res.Df[2], het_test$F[2]),
    `p-value` = sprintf("%.3f", p), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
sem_het_table <- do.call(rbind, sem_het_rows)

# Display Black-only F-tests in Part 1
sem_het_black <- sem_het_table[1:3, ]
min_p_black <- min(as.numeric(sem_het_black$`p-value`))
sem_het_black <- rbind(sem_het_black, data.frame(
  Outcome = "Minimum p-value", `F-stat` = "", `p-value` = sprintf("%.3f", min_p_black),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
pdf_table(sem_het_black, caption = "Semester Heterogeneity F-tests: Black (Fall vs Spring)")
```

```{r table-s12, results='asis'}
compute_rank_cs <- function(theta, Sigma, alpha = 0.05, R_draws = 10000, seed = 12345) {
  set.seed(seed)
  p <- length(theta)
  point_ranks <- rank(-theta)
  L <- chol(Sigma)
  Z_raw <- matrix(rnorm(R_draws * p), nrow = R_draws, ncol = p)
  Z <- Z_raw %*% L
  se_mat <- matrix(NA, p, p)
  for (i in 1:p) for (j in 1:p) if (i != j)
    se_mat[i, j] <- sqrt(Sigma[i,i] + Sigma[j,j] - 2 * Sigma[i,j])
  marginal_L <- marginal_U <- rep(NA, p)
  for (i in 1:p) {
    n_better <- n_worse <- 0
    for (j in 1:p) {
      if (j == i) next
      t_ij <- (theta[i] - theta[j]) / se_mat[i, j]
      z_diff <- (Z[, i] - Z[, j]) / se_mat[i, j]
      if (t_ij < quantile(z_diff, alpha)) n_better <- n_better + 1
      if (t_ij > quantile(z_diff, 1 - alpha)) n_worse <- n_worse + 1
    }
    marginal_L[i] <- 1 + n_better
    marginal_U[i] <- p - n_worse
  }
  max_stats <- rep(NA, R_draws)
  for (b in 1:R_draws) {
    max_val <- 0
    for (i in 1:(p - 1)) for (j in (i + 1):p) {
      stat <- abs(Z[b, i] - Z[b, j]) / se_mat[i, j]
      if (stat > max_val) max_val <- stat
    }
    max_stats[b] <- max_val
  }
  cv_simul <- quantile(max_stats, 1 - alpha)
  simul_L <- simul_U <- rep(NA, p)
  for (i in 1:p) {
    n_better <- n_worse <- 0
    for (j in 1:p) {
      if (j == i) next
      t_ij <- (theta[i] - theta[j]) / se_mat[i, j]
      if (t_ij < -cv_simul) n_better <- n_better + 1
      if (t_ij > cv_simul) n_worse <- n_worse + 1
    }
    simul_L[i] <- 1 + n_better
    simul_U[i] <- p - n_worse
  }
  in_best_set <- rep(FALSE, p)
  for (i in 1:p) {
    max_against_boot <- rep(NA, R_draws)
    for (b in 1:R_draws) {
      max_val <- -Inf
      for (j in 1:p) {
        if (j == i) next
        stat <- (Z[b, j] - Z[b, i]) / se_mat[i, j]
        if (stat > max_val) max_val <- stat
      }
      max_against_boot[b] <- max_val
    }
    cv_best <- quantile(max_against_boot, 1 - alpha)
    max_against_obs <- max(sapply(setdiff(1:p, i), function(j) (theta[j] - theta[i]) / se_mat[i, j]))
    in_best_set[i] <- (max_against_obs <= cv_best)
  }
  data.frame(point_rank = point_ranks, marginal_L = marginal_L, marginal_U = marginal_U,
             simul_L = simul_L, simul_U = simul_U, in_best_set = in_best_set)
}

disc_coef_names <- c("disciplineChemistry:treatment", "disciplineComputer Science:treatment",
  "disciplineMathematics:treatment", "disciplineMechanical Engineering:treatment",
  "disciplinePhysics:treatment")
disc_labels <- c("Chemistry", "Computer Science", "Mathematics", "Mechanical Engineering", "Physics")

outcome_models <- list(pct_black = models_black_disc[["(2)"]], num_black = models_black_disc[["(4)"]], has_any_black = models_black_disc[["(6)"]])
outcome_labels <- c(pct_black = "Pct. Black Speakers", num_black = "Num. Black Speakers", has_any_black = "Any Black Speaker")

rank_cs_pooled <- list()
rank_cs_export <- data.frame()
for (outcome in names(outcome_models)) {
  model <- outcome_models[[outcome]]
  theta <- coef(model)[disc_coef_names]
  V_sub <- vcovCL(model, cluster = ~ department_std)[disc_coef_names, disc_coef_names]
  cs <- compute_rank_cs(theta, V_sub)
  cs$Discipline <- disc_labels
  cs$Estimate <- as.numeric(theta)
  cs$SE <- sqrt(diag(V_sub))
  cs$outcome <- outcome
  rank_cs_pooled[[outcome]] <- cs

  cs_p <- cs[order(cs$point_rank), ]
  display_df <- data.frame(
    Discipline = cs_p$Discipline,
    `Effect (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", cs_p$Estimate, cs_p$SE),
    `Point Rank` = cs_p$point_rank,
    `Marginal 95% CS` = sprintf("[%d, %d]", cs_p$marginal_L, cs_p$marginal_U),
    `Simultaneous 95% CS` = sprintf("[%d, %d]", cs_p$simul_L, cs_p$simul_U),
    `In Best Set` = ifelse(cs_p$in_best_set, "Yes", ""), check.names = FALSE
  )
  safe_label <- gsub("#", "\\\\#", outcome_labels[outcome])
  print(pdf_table(display_df, caption = paste("Table S9: Rank CS --", safe_label)))

  block <- data.frame(
    Outcome = c(outcome_labels[outcome], rep("", nrow(cs_p) - 1)),
    Discipline = cs_p$Discipline, Estimate = round(cs_p$Estimate, 3), SE = round(cs_p$SE, 3),
    Point_Rank = cs_p$point_rank,
    Marginal_CS = sprintf("[%d, %d]", cs_p$marginal_L, cs_p$marginal_U),
    Simultaneous_CS = sprintf("[%d, %d]", cs_p$simul_L, cs_p$simul_U),
    In_Best_Set = ifelse(cs_p$in_best_set, "Yes", ""), check.names = FALSE
  )
  rank_cs_export <- rbind(rank_cs_export, block)
}
```

```{r table-s25}
table_s25_base <- modelsummary(models_s25, stars = TRUE, fmt = 4, coef_map = coef_map_full,
  gof_map = c("nobs", "adj.r.squared"), vcov = vcov_cluster_custom, output = "data.frame")

pdf_table(table_s25_export, caption = "Table S12: Black Speaker Representation by Black Organizer Status", scale_down = TRUE)

models_s25_int <- list(
  "(1)" = lm(as.formula(paste("pct_black ~ treatment * any_black_organizer +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(2)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_black ~ treatment * any_black_organizer +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(3)" = lm(as.formula(paste("has_any_black ~ treatment * any_black_organizer +", controls_extended)), data = final_data)
)
int_rows_s25 <- list()
dv_labels_s25 <- c("% Black", "# Black", "Any Black")
for (i in 1:3) {
  m <- models_s25_int[[i]]
  ct <- coeftest(m, vcovCL(m, cluster = ~department_std))
  int_rows_s25[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Outcome = dv_labels_s25[i],
    Estimate = sprintf("%.3f", ct["treatment:any_black_organizer", 1]),
    SE = sprintf("(%.3f)", ct["treatment:any_black_organizer", 2]),
    `p-value` = sprintf("%.3f", ct["treatment:any_black_organizer", 4]),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
pdf_table(do.call(rbind, int_rows_s25), caption = "Interaction: Treatment x Any Black Organizer")
```

```{r table-s5}
sur_system_urm <- list(
  urm = as.formula(paste("num_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended)),
  nonurm = as.formula(paste("num_non_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended))
)
sur_model_urm <- tryCatch(
  systemfit(sur_system_urm, method = "SUR", data = final_data),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (is.null(sur_model_urm)) {
  cat("SUR failed in Table S5; reporting clustered equation-by-equation models with NA Wald rows.\n")
  wald_eq_f_urm <- NA_real_
  wald_eq_p_urm <- NA_real_
  wald_sub_f_urm <- NA_real_
  wald_sub_p_urm <- NA_real_
  wald_df2_urm <- NA_real_
} else {
  wald_test_equality_urm <- linearHypothesis(sur_model_urm, "urm_treatment = nonurm_treatment")
  wald_test_substitution_urm <- linearHypothesis(sur_model_urm, "urm_treatment + nonurm_treatment = 0")
  wald_eq_f_urm <- wald_test_equality_urm$F[2]
  wald_eq_p_urm <- wald_test_equality_urm$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  wald_sub_f_urm <- wald_test_substitution_urm$F[2]
  wald_sub_p_urm <- wald_test_substitution_urm$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  wald_df2_urm <- sur_model_urm$df.residual
}

models_s4 <- list(
  "(1)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(2)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_non_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended)), data = final_data)
)
table_s4_base <- modelsummary(models_s4, stars = TRUE, fmt = 4, coef_map = coef_map_full,
  gof_map = c("nobs", "adj.r.squared"), output = "data.frame", vcov = ~department_std)
table_s4_export <- table_s4_base

for (test_info in list(
  list(label = "Wald: Diff in Magnitude (H0: URM = non-URM)",
       f = wald_eq_f_urm, p = wald_eq_p_urm),
  list(label = "Wald: Substitution (H0: URM + non-URM = 0)",
       f = wald_sub_f_urm, p = wald_sub_p_urm)
)) {
  wald_stat <- if (is.na(wald_df2_urm)) {
    sprintf("F = %.3f, p = %.3f", test_info$f, test_info$p)
  } else {
    sprintf("F(1,%.0f) = %.3f, p = %.3f", wald_df2_urm, test_info$f, test_info$p)
  }
  wald_row <- data.frame(part = "gof", term = test_info$label,
    statistic = wald_stat,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for(col in names(table_s4_export)[4:length(names(table_s4_export))]) wald_row[[col]] <- ""
  table_s4_export <- rbind(table_s4_export, wald_row)
}
pdf_table(table_s4_export, caption = "Extended Table E2: URM vs Non-URM Substitution (SUR)",
         col_groups = c(" " = 1, "# URM" = 1, "# Non-URM" = 1))
```

```{r iv-diagnostics, include=FALSE}
compliance_rate <- mean(final_data$accessed_database[final_data$treatment == 1])
first_stage <- lm(as.formula(paste("accessed_database ~ treatment +", controls_extended)), data = final_data)
first_stage_clustered <- coeftest(first_stage, vcovCL(first_stage, cluster = ~department_std))
fs_coef <- first_stage_clustered["treatment", "Estimate"]
fs_t <- first_stage_clustered["treatment", "t value"]
fs_f <- fs_t^2
cat(sprintf("Compliance rate: %.1f%%, First-stage F = %.2f\n",
            100 * compliance_rate, fs_f))
```

```{r table-s16}
)) {
  wald_row <- data.frame(part = "gof", term = wald_info$label,
    statistic = sprintf("F = %.3f, p = %.4f", wald_info$f, wald_info$p), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (col in names(table_s13_export)[4:length(names(table_s13_export))]) wald_row[[col]] <- ""
  table_s13_export <- rbind(table_s13_export, wald_row)
}
pdf_table(table_s13_export, caption = "Extended Table E9: Hispanic Decomposition (From Database vs. Not From Database)", landscape_mode = TRUE, font_size = 9,
         col_groups = list(
           c(" " = 1, "From DB" = 2, "Not From DB" = 2, "From DB" = 2, "Not From DB" = 2),
           c(" " = 1, "% Hispanic" = 4, "# Hispanic" = 4)))
```

```{r table-s17}
models_s14 <- list(
  "(1)" = lm(as.formula(paste("pct_urm_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_base)), data = final_data),
  "(2)" = lm(as.formula(paste("pct_urm_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(3)" = lm(as.formula(paste("pct_urm_not_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_base)), data = final_data),
  "(4)" = lm(as.formula(paste("pct_urm_not_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(5)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_urm_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_base)), data = final_data),
  "(6)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_urm_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(7)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_urm_not_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_base)), data = final_data),
  "(8)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_urm_not_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended)), data = final_data)
)

table_s14_base <- modelsummary(models_s14, stars = TRUE, fmt = 4, coef_map = coef_map_full,
  gof_map = c("nobs", "adj.r.squared"), vcov = ~department_std, output = "data.frame")

sur_pct_urm_decomp <- tryCatch(
  systemfit(list(
    fromDB = as.formula(paste("pct_urm_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended)),
    notFromDB = as.formula(paste("pct_urm_not_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended))
  ), method = "SUR", data = final_data),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (is.null(sur_pct_urm_decomp)) {
  wald_pct_urm_decomp_f <- NA_real_
  wald_pct_urm_decomp_p <- NA_real_
} else {
  wald_pct_urm_decomp <- linearHypothesis(sur_pct_urm_decomp, "fromDB_treatment = notFromDB_treatment")
  wald_pct_urm_decomp_f <- wald_pct_urm_decomp$F[2]
  wald_pct_urm_decomp_p <- wald_pct_urm_decomp$`Pr(>F)`[2]
}

sur_num_urm_decomp <- tryCatch(
  systemfit(list(
    fromDB = as.formula(paste("num_urm_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended)),
    notFromDB = as.formula(paste("num_urm_not_from_db ~ treatment +", controls_extended))
  ), method = "SUR", data = final_data),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (is.null(sur_num_urm_decomp)) {
  wald_num_urm_decomp_f <- NA_real_
  wald_num_urm_decomp_p <- NA_real_
} else {
  wald_num_urm_decomp <- linearHypothesis(sur_num_urm_decomp, "fromDB_treatment = notFromDB_treatment")
  wald_num_urm_decomp_f <- wald_num_urm_decomp$F[2]
  wald_num_urm_decomp_p <- wald_num_urm_decomp$`Pr(>F)`[2]
}

table_s14_export <- table_s14_base
for (wald_info in list(
  list(label = "Wald: from_db = not_from_db (pct)", f = wald_pct_urm_decomp_f, p = wald_pct_urm_decomp_p),
  list(label = "Wald: from_db = not_from_db (num)", f = wald_num_urm_decomp_f, p = wald_num_urm_decomp_p)
)) {
  wald_row <- data.frame(part = "gof", term = wald_info$label,
    statistic = sprintf("F = %.3f, p = %.4f", wald_info$f, wald_info$p), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (col in names(table_s14_export)[4:length(names(table_s14_export))]) wald_row[[col]] <- ""
  table_s14_export <- rbind(table_s14_export, wald_row)
}
pdf_table(table_s14_export, caption = "Extended Table E10: URM Decomposition (From Database vs. Not From Database)", landscape_mode = TRUE, font_size = 9,
         col_groups = list(
           c(" " = 1, "From DB" = 2, "Not From DB" = 2, "From DB" = 2, "Not From DB" = 2),
           c(" " = 1, "% URM" = 4, "# URM" = 4)))
```

```{r table-s26}
data_no_urm_org <- final_data %>% filter(any_urm_organizer == 0)
data_any_urm_org <- final_data %>% filter(any_urm_organizer == 1)

models_s26 <- c(
  list("(1)" = run_subgroup_model(paste("pct_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended), data_no_urm_org),
       "(2)" = run_subgroup_model(paste("num_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended), data_no_urm_org),
       "(3)" = run_subgroup_model(paste("has_any_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended), data_no_urm_org)),
  list("(4)" = run_subgroup_model(paste("pct_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended), data_any_urm_org),
       "(5)" = run_subgroup_model(paste("num_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended), data_any_urm_org),
       "(6)" = run_subgroup_model(paste("has_any_urm ~ treatment +", controls_extended), data_any_urm_org))
)
table_s26_base <- modelsummary(models_s26, stars = TRUE, fmt = 4, coef_map = coef_map_full,
  gof_map = c("nobs", "adj.r.squared"), vcov = vcov_cluster_custom, output = "data.frame")
table_s26_export <- table_s26_base
pdf_table(table_s26_export, caption = "Extended Table E13: URM Speaker Representation by URM Organizer Status", scale_down = TRUE)

models_s26_int <- list(
  "(1)" = lm(as.formula(paste("pct_urm ~ treatment * any_urm_organizer +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(2)" = lm(as.formula(paste("num_urm ~ treatment * any_urm_organizer +", controls_extended)), data = final_data),
  "(3)" = lm(as.formula(paste("has_any_urm ~ treatment * any_urm_organizer +", controls_extended)), data = final_data)
)
int_rows_s26 <- list()
dv_labels_s26 <- c("% URM", "# URM", "Any URM")
for (i in 1:3) {
  m <- models_s26_int[[i]]
  ct <- coeftest(m, vcovCL(m, cluster = ~department_std))
  int_rows_s26[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Outcome = dv_labels_s26[i],
    Estimate = sprintf("%.3f", ct["treatment:any_urm_organizer", 1]),
    SE = sprintf("(%.3f)", ct["treatment:any_urm_organizer", 2]),
    `p-value` = sprintf("%.3f", ct["treatment:any_urm_organizer", 4]),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
pdf_table(do.call(rbind, int_rows_s26), caption = "Interaction: Treatment x Any URM Organizer")
```
